description: This file defines the interface ICallChainReentrantGrainContext which provides methods for managing reentrant sections within grains in the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ICallChainReentrantGrainContext
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for marking the beginning and end of reentrant sections within a grain, allowing requests with the same ReentrancyId to re-enter the grain during those sections.

methods.name: OnEnterReentrantSection
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a reentrant section within a grain for the specified reentrancy ID.

methods.name: OnExitReentrantSection
methods.description: Marks the end of a reentrant section within a grain for the specified reentrancy ID.
